messages:
mia_marketing: Quick sync  48h to go. We need final docs URL, canary window, and HubSpot form to lock the announce time.

sam_engineering: Canary plan: 30m smoke -> 90m canary -> progressive ramp. Canary start proposed 2026-03-29T04:00:00Z. End conditions: rollback if 5xx >1.5% for 10m or median latency +25%.

anya_docs: Docs PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/507. Changelog and migration notes included. If we merge, canonical will be https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2026-03-29.

leo_product: Merge if possible. Add a single sentence for Dedicated customers: "Contact CS for assisted rollouts."

zara_sales: HubSpot form: https://hub.redwood.ai/forms/mar29-launch. Tags: ["mar29-launch","bench-webinar"]. Ensure benchmark blog links append utm_source=benchmark.

mia_marketing: Draft announce copy: "New release: faster cold starts, opt-in model pinning, and smarter batching. Changelog + docs: <canonical link>. Webinar Thurs 10:00 PT  register." Will swap canonical link once docs merged.

sam_engineering: Canary endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings, /v1/chat-stream. Throttle 12rps in canary, ramp to 48rps on success. Perf will attach median-latency PNG by EOD.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: smoke 2026-03-29T03:30:00Z; canary 2026-03-29T04:00:00Z -> 2026-03-29T05:30:00Z; ramp 2026-03-29T06:00:00Z. Rollback thresholds as posted.

mia_marketing: Final checklist: 1) canonical docs URL (anya), 2) canary endpoints + thresholds (sam), 3) HubSpot + tags (zara), 4) bench PNG (sam). If green, target publish 2026-03-29 15:00 PT. Ping @marketing-alert on any slips.

anya_docs: Will merge after final proof at 2026-03-28T21:00:00Z. I'll add a note about the `enable_model_pinning` flag so customers know it's opt-in.

sam_engineering: PNG uploaded to the thread: https://files.redwood.ai/perf/mar29-median-latency.png. All tests passing on staging.

mia_marketing: Awesome  locking schedule and starting asset prep. Thanks team! :sparkles:
